description:
Draft the ARCH.md + TAXONOMY.md edits captured in a design discussion on 2026-04-23. The design (converged with user) is a substantial restructuring of the conversation-repo model.

=== Core decisions ===

1. Terminology collapse. "Invocation" retires as a distinct term. "Conversation" becomes the primitive (every dispatch yields a conversation; the root conversation has no parent and terminates to user input rather than merging up). "Exchange" survives as a UX label for "conversation initiated by a user message" — non-structural.

2. Control plane / data plane split. The conversation repo is data only. Control (workflows, tools, skills, adapters) lives at the harness root (~/.lernie/ by default, overridable). Per-conversation control files (manifest.yaml, workflow.yaml, providers.yaml role→model, souls/<role>.md) are frozen copies at the conversation root OUTSIDE the worktrees.

3. Worktree invariant. Anything inside a worktree is composed into the prompt. No filter lists. Worktree contents: goal.md, soul.md (swapped in at dispatch), summary/NNN.md (branch-scoped), steps/<id>/NNN/{request.json, response.json, tools/}, descriptions/, skills/ (loaded content).

4. Merge mechanics. .gitattributes with merge=ours for goal.md, soul.md, summary/** — parent keeps its own on merge-back from subagent. Steps namespaced by invocation id so they don't collide.

5. Directory layout. ~/.lernie/conversations/<conv_id>/ with flat control files at root, 'root/' for primary worktree, sibling '<a>-<b>/' '<a>-<b>-<c>/' for subagent worktrees. Hierarchy in the name, not nesting (avoids git-in-git footgun).

6. No <ts> prefix. Hierarchy in directory names; ordering from git/fs metadata.

7. Skills copied (not symlinked) at load time. Descriptions inherited via git from main. Portability principle.

=== Sections impacted ===

docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:
- §1 Overview — mentions of exchanges/invocations as distinct
- §2.1 Terms table — retire Invocation, redefine Conversation, demote Exchange to UX label
- §2.2 The Conversation Repo — major rewrite of disk layout
- §2.3 Branches and the branch invariant — collapse ex/*/inv/* split, new branch naming
- §2.4 Exchanges — shrink to note on UX
- §2.5 Invocations and dispatch — retitle + simplify
- §2.6 Merges — add merge=ours note
- §2.7 Compaction — note intermediate-summary containment
- §3.1 Disk as Bus — update paths (no .agent/)
- §3.5 UI contract — update paths
- §5 Context Assembly — manifest.yaml role-keyed, make the worktree invariant explicit

docs/TAXONOMY.md:
- Term entries for conversation, invocation, exchange

=== Gates (per project AGENTS.md) ===
- tests: no code touched; cargo test/coverage should pass trivially; verify at review.
- docs: this task IS the docs update.
- alignment: check coherence against PRINCIPLES.md and banned-term rule in ARCH §2.1.

=== Out of scope ===
- Code/implementation changes (separate downstream tasks).
- Updating schemas/ or src/config/.
- bl-e2fb tool contract work (separate ball, narrower focus).
title: Draft ARCH/TAXONOMY redesign: conversation as primitive, .agent/ split, worktree invariant
